title: Evaluation of a factorization-normalized cofinal support square
statement:
Let X,Y,f,c,l,T,B,r,Lx,Ly,R,Fx,Fy be actual projection, selected-extension, repetition and factorization data of [def-pur-etale-system-cofinal-data]. Suppose the coefficient projection for cofinalCoefficient B r is invertible and its evaluation agrees with compactScalarMap, in the precise coefficient-evaluation word of [lem-pur-etale-system-coefficient-projection]. Assume in addition the three explicit repetition and factor evaluation diagrams CofinalBlockEvaluation of [lem-pur-etale-cofinal-block-factorization]. If h is a natural isomorphism from Lx followed by compact support over B to compact support over the selected tower followed by Ly, and h satisfies the factorization normalization using R.kappa, then its evaluated morphisms satisfy the CofinalSupport.evaluation equation. This is a conditional equality for fixed data, with no existence assertion.

Precise Lean statement (notation and universes as in the cited definition):
```lean
theorem etaleCofinalSupport_evaluation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {c : Compactification f} {l : ℕ}
    (T : Theory c l) (B : Coefficients.{u} l) (r : ℕ ↪o ℕ)
    (Lx : CofinalExtension X B r) (Ly : CofinalExtension Y B r)
    (R : CofinalRepeatSupport T B r)
    (Fx : CofinalFactor X B r Lx R.x (T.scalarX (cofinalCoefficient B r)))
    (Fy : CofinalFactor Y B r Ly R.y (T.scalarY (cofinalCoefficient B r)))
    (data : CofinalBlockEvaluation T B r Lx Ly R Fx Fy)
    [IsIso (T.q (cofinalCoefficient B r))]
    (hq : ∀ (m : ℕ) (M : Derived X (cofinalRepeated B r).rings),
      (scalarExtension ((cofinalCoefficient B r).app (op m)).hom Y).map
          ((T.supportEvaluation (cofinalRepeated B r) m).iso.inv.app M) ≫
        (T.scalarEvaluationY (cofinalCoefficient B r) m).iso.inv.app
          ((T.support (cofinalRepeated B r)).F.obj M) ≫
        (T.evaluationY B m).E.map ((T.q (cofinalCoefficient B r)).app M) ≫
        (T.supportEvaluation B m).iso.hom.app
          ((T.scalarX (cofinalCoefficient B r)).model.T.obj M) ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (B.rings.obj (op m))) c).map
            ((T.scalarEvaluationX (cofinalCoefficient B r) m).iso.hom.app M) =
        (compactScalarMap ((cofinalCoefficient B r).app (op m)).hom c).app
          ((T.evaluationX (cofinalRepeated B r) m).E.obj M))
    (h : Lx.model.derived ⋙ (T.support B).F ≅
      (T.support (cofinalCoefficients B r)).F ⋙ Ly.model.derived)
    (hn : ∀ N : Derived X (cofinalCoefficients B r).rings,
      (T.q (cofinalCoefficient B r)).app (R.x.R.mapDerivedCategory.obj N) ≫
        (T.support B).F.map (Fx.derived.inv.app N) ≫ h.hom.app N ≫
        Fy.derived.hom.app ((T.support (cofinalCoefficients B r)).F.obj N) =
      (T.scalarY (cofinalCoefficient B r)).model.T.map (R.kappa.hom.app N)) :
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (N : Derived X (cofinalCoefficients B r).rings),
    ((T.evaluationY B m).E).map (h.hom.app N) ≫
      (Ly.level m (T.evaluationY B m)
        (T.evaluationY (cofinalCoefficients B r)
          (SheafOfModules.systemNextSelected r m))).hom.app
            ((T.support (cofinalCoefficients B r)).F.obj N) ≫
      (scalarExtension
        (B.rings.map (homOfLE (SheafOfModules.systemNextSelected_spec r m).1).op).hom Y).map
          ((T.supportEvaluation (cofinalCoefficients B r)
            (SheafOfModules.systemNextSelected r m)).iso.hom.app N) ≫
      (compactScalarMap
        (B.rings.map (homOfLE (SheafOfModules.systemNextSelected_spec r m).1).op).hom c).app
          ((T.evaluationX (cofinalCoefficients B r)
            (SheafOfModules.systemNextSelected r m)).E.obj N) =
    (T.supportEvaluation B m).iso.hom.app
      (Lx.model.derived.obj N) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (B.rings.obj (op m))) c).map
        ((Lx.level m (T.evaluationX B m)
          (T.evaluationX (cofinalCoefficients B r)
            (SheafOfModules.systemNextSelected r m))).hom.app N)
```

proof.text: solve the normalization equation for h by composing with the inverse coefficient projection and the inverse factorization comparisons. Evaluate this word at m. Substitute data.factorX and data.factorY to identify the evaluated factorization words with the recorded selected-extension level comparisons. Use naturality of scalar evaluation to move past R.kappa, and then use data.support for the repeated compact-support square. The remaining coefficient square is exactly the assumed projection evaluation formula for D_m→B_m; naturality moves the repeated-evaluation isomorphisms past its scalar map. Cancel the adjacent evaluation and factorization isomorphisms. The remaining word is the displayed selected-extension/support equation. This is a diagram calculation from three explicitly recorded evaluation diagrams, not an inference from faithfulness of level evaluation. It does not demand literal section identities for arbitrary choices of open-adjoint data. Repeated least indices and nonflat coefficients are allowed.
